name: io.github.jirizaloudek/agentalerts
title: AgentAlerts
description: SEC 8-K, Form 4 insider & 13D activist alerts; stock/crypto/FX price alerts for AI agents. AI-run.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a free anonymous account and get an API key (aa_...). No email or personal data needed. Store the key; pass it as Authorization: Bearer <key> or append ?key=<key> to the MCP URL.

label.description: Optional nickname, e.g. your agent name.

tools.name: get_filings
tools.description: Recent SEC EDGAR filings for a US-listed company (8-K material events with item explanations, 10-Q/10-K, Form 4 insider trades, 13D/G, ...). Free, no account needed. Links go to sec.gov.

tools.name: latest_filings
tools.description: Market-wide feed of the latest SEC 8-K filings (material events) from all US public companies, with tickers and item codes explained (earnings, officer changes, M&A, cyber incidents, restatements). Free, no account needed. Optional filter by item codes.

items.description: Only filings containing any of these 8-K items, e.g. ["5.02","1.05"]

tools.name: insider_trades
tools.description: SEC Form 4 insider trades in plain English: who (name, role), bought or sold, how many shares, at what price, total value, 10b5-1 plan flag. Market-wide (all US public companies, refreshed every ~2 min) or for one ticker. Free, no account needed. Filter kind=buy for open-market insider purchases.

ticker.description: Optional, e.g. NVDA. Omit for the market-wide feed.

kind.description: buy = open-market purchase (code P), sell = open-market sale (S), other = grants, exercises, tax withholding, gifts

min_value.description: Minimum transaction value in USD, e.g. 100000

tools.name: activist_stakes
tools.description: SEC Schedule 13D/13G 5%+ ownership stakes in plain English: who holds what % of a company, activist (13D) vs passive (13G), with an excerpt of the stated purpose (Item 4). Market-wide latest 13D filings, or all recent 13D/13G for one ticker. Free, no account needed.

ticker.description: Optional, e.g. BILL. Omit for the market-wide latest 13D feed.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Tell the operator about problems. CALL THIS whenever you hit an error, an unclear or surprising result, missing data or a missing feature, or had to retry or work around something. Do not wait to be asked; one short factual message is enough (what you tried, what happened, what you expected). No account needed. Feedback is reviewed daily and acted on. Do not include secrets or personal data.

message.description: What you tried, what went wrong / was unclear / is missing (5-1000 chars).

tool.description: Which tool or endpoint, if relevant.

tools.name: get_rate
tools.description: Latest FX rate (ECB reference, daily) or crypto price (Coinbase public rates). Stock quotes are not provided (licensing) – use a price alert instead.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Account info: default channels, webhook signing secret, alert counts.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Set default notification channels (used by alerts without their own channels) and/or label.

default_channels.description: Notification channels. Items: {"type":"webhook","url":"https://..."} (HMAC-signed JSON POST) | {"type":"ntfy","topic":"long-secret-topic"} (free push via ntfy.sh – phone app, or your agent can subscribe to https://ntfy.sh/<topic>/json). Shorthand strings: "https://..." or "ntfy:<topic>".

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create one alert, evaluated server-side so your agent does not need to stay running: kind=price (stock / crypto / fx threshold) or kind=filing (notify on each new SEC filing of a company you follow).

kind.description: 'price' (default) = price threshold alert; 'filing' = new SEC filing for a company; 'insider' = Form 4 insider trade (symbol=ticker or '*' for all US companies, trade=buy|sell|any, min_value USD).

min_value.description: kind=insider: minimum trade value in USD (market-wide symbol='*' needs >= 50000).

provider.description: For kind=price. stock: Delayed stock prices from a licensed source. Notifications report that your condition was met (derived signal); raw quotes are not redistributed. e.g. AAPL, MSFT, SAP.XETRA | crypto: Coinbase public exchange rates, any BASE-QUOTE pair. Checked every 5 min. e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-EUR | fx: ECB euro reference rates, updated once per business day (~16:00 CET). e.g. EUR/CZK, USD/JPY

symbol.description: Ticker / pair. stock: AAPL, SAP.XETRA; crypto: BTC-USD; fx: EUR/CZK; filing: US SEC ticker like AAPL, TSLA, BRK-B.

condition.description: kind=price: 'below' fires when price <= target, 'above' when price >= target.

target.description: kind=price: target price in the instrument currency.

repeat.description: kind=price: false (default) fire once; true = re-arm after the price moves back across the target.

forms.description: kind=filing: SEC form types to watch. Default: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, 6-K, 20-F, S-1, SC 13D, SC 13G, 4, DEF 14A. Use ["*"] for all forms, ["8-K"] for material events only, ["4"] for insider trades.

note.description: Free text included in your notification (e.g. "thesis: ..., action: review position"). Private, never shown on public pages.

channels.description: Notification channels. Items: {"type":"webhook","url":"https://..."} (HMAC-signed JSON POST) | {"type":"ntfy","topic":"long-secret-topic"} (free push via ntfy.sh – phone app, or your agent can subscribe to https://ntfy.sh/<topic>/json). Shorthand strings: "https://..." or "ntfy:<topic>".

external_id.description: Your own stable id (e.g. "NVDA-buy-1" or "AAPL-filings") for idempotent upserts.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO date after which the alert expires.

tools.name: upsert_alerts
tools.description: Bulk create/update alerts keyed by external_id – sync a whole watchlist (e.g. recalculated buy/sell levels + filing watches) in one call. Changing a target re-arms a triggered alert. replace_all=true deletes your alerts not in the list.

tools.description: Send a test notification to given channels (or your default channels).
